PKG_REL_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"

ET.register_namespace("", MAIN_NS)

def q(tag):
    return f"{{{MAIN_NS}}}{tag}"

def find_sheet_xml_path(zf, sheet_name="Sheet1"):
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {
        rel.attrib["Id"]: rel.attrib["Target"]
        for rel in rels_root.findall(f"{{{PKG_REL_NS}}}Relationship")

        if sh.attrib.get("name") == sheet_name:
            rid = sh.attrib.get(f"{{{REL_NS}}}id")
            target = rel_map[rid]
            if target.startswith("/"):
                return target.lstrip("/")
            return posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join("xl", target))
    return "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"

def cell_text(cell, shared_strings):
    if cell is None:
        return ""
    cell_type = cell.attrib.get("t")
    if cell_type == "inlineStr":
        is_el = cell.find(q("is"))
        if is_el is None:
            return ""
        return "".join(t.text or "" for t in is_el.findall(f".//{q('t')}"))
    if cell_type == "s":
        v = cell.find(q("v"))
        if v is None or v.text is None:
            return ""
        try:
            return shared_strings[int(v.text)]
        except Exception:
            return ""
    v = cell.find(q("v"))
    return "" if v is None or v.text is None else str(v.text)

def load_shared_strings(zf):
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" not in zf.namelist():
        return []
    root = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    out = []
    for si in root.findall(q("si")):
        out.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.findall(f".//{q('t')}")))
    return out

def text_node(text):
    t = ET.Element(q("t"))
    if text.startswith((" ", "\t", "\n")) or text.endswith((" ", "\t", "\n")):
        t.set(f"{{{XML_NS}}}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return t

def add_plain_run(is_el, text):

        r = ET.SubElement(is_el, q("r"))
        r.append(text_node(text))

def add_highlight_run(is_el, text):
    if not text:

    r = ET.SubElement(is_el, q("r"))
    rpr = ET.SubElement(r, q("rPr"))
    ET.SubElement(rpr, q("rFont"), {"val": "等线"})
    ET.SubElement(rpr, q("family"), {"val": "2"})

# Editable search list.  Matching is whole-token/whole-word only, so "too"

patterns = [

    if p and p.lower() not in seen:
        seen.add(p.lower())
        clean_patterns.append(p)
clean_patterns.sort(key=«redacted» reverse=True)

def compile_pattern(p):
    body = re.escape(p)
    body = re.sub(r"\\\s+", r"\\s+", body)
    left = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])" if p[0].isalnum() else ""
    right = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9])" if p[-1].isalnum() else ""
    return re.compile(left + body + right, re.IGNORECASE)

compiled = [(p, compile_pattern(p)) for p in clean_patterns]

def match_spans(text):
    used = [False] * len(text)
    spans = []
    for _, rx in compiled:
        for m in rx.finditer(text):
            s, e = m.span()
            if s == e or any(used[s:e]):
                continue
            spans.append((s, e))
            for i in range(s, e):
                used[i] = True
    return sorted(spans)

def make_rich_cell(old_cell, ref, text, spans):
    attrs = dict(old_cell.attrib) if old_cell is not None else {"r": ref}
    attrs["r"] = ref
    attrs["t"] = "inlineStr"
    attrs.pop("cm", None)
    attrs.pop("vm", None)

    new_cell = ET.Element(q("c"), attrs)
    is_el = ET.SubElement(new_cell, q("is"))

    pos = 0
    for s, e in spans:
        add_plain_run(is_el, text[pos:s])
        add_highlight_run(is_el, text[s:e])
        pos = e
    add_plain_run(is_el, text[pos:])

def color_is_red(color):
    """Return True for the usual Excel red encodings."""
    if color is None:
        return False
    try:
        if color.type == "rgb" and color.rgb:
            rgb = str(color.rgb).upper()
            return rgb in {"FFFF0000", "FF0000"}
        if color.type == "indexed":
            return color.indexed == 10
    except Exception:
        pass
    return False


def font_is_bold_red(font):
    if font is None:
        return False
    bold = bool(getattr(font, "b", False) or getattr(font, "bold", False))
    return bold and color_is_red(getattr(font, "color", None))


def cell_text(value):

patterns = []
if rich_text_available:
    for row in range(2, 34):

        if isinstance(val, CellRichText):
            buf = ""
            for part in val:
                if isinstance(part, TextBlock) and font_is_bold_red(part.font):
                    buf += part.text

# Sort longest first so phrases like "too good" win before "too".
clean_patterns.sort(key=«redacted» reverse=True)


def make_regex_for_pattern(pattern):
    escaped = re.escape(pattern.strip())
    escaped = re.sub(r"\\\s+", r"\\s+", escaped)
    prefix = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])" if pattern and pattern[0].isalnum() else ""
    suffix = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9])" if pattern and pattern[-1].isalnum() else ""
    return re.compile(prefix + escaped + suffix, re.IGNORECASE)


compiled = [(p, make_regex_for_pattern(p)) for p in clean_patterns]

# Bold red inline font for highlighted matches.
if rich_text_available:
    red_bold_font = InlineFont(b=True, color="FFFF0000")


def find_non_overlapping_matches(text):
    occupied = [False] * len(text)
    matches = []
    for _, rx in compiled:
        for m in rx.finditer(text):
            s, e = m.span()
            if s == e:
                continue
            if any(occupied[s:e]):
                continue
            matches.append((s, e))
            for i in range(s, e):
                occupied[i] = True
    matches.sort()
    return matches


# Modify only the permitted range: Sheet1!BD2:BD308.
for row in range(2, 309):
    cell = ws[f"BD{row}"]

        continue

    text = cell_text(cell.value)
    matches = find_non_overlapping_matches(text)

    if not matches:
        continue

    if rich_text_available:
        pieces = []
        pos = 0
        for s, e in matches:
            if s > pos:
                pieces.append(text[pos:s])
            pieces.append(TextBlock(red_bold_font, text[s:e]))
            pos = e
        if pos < len(text):
            pieces.append(text[pos:])
        cell.value = CellRichText(*pieces)
    else:
        # Last-resort fallback if openpyxl has no rich text writer:
        # keep the value and mark the full cell bold red rather than touching
        # anything outside the allowed range.
        cell.value = text
        new_font = copy(cell.font)
        new_font.bold = True
        new_font.color = "FFFF0000"
        cell.font = new_font

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

def token_regex(p):
